animals.strain: Zeb1+/+ and Zeb1+/- mice on a C57BL/6J background
animals.eyes: one cornea debrided per mouse; the other eye untreated

wound.method: central corneal epithelium marked with a 2 mm trephine and debrided with Alger Brush II under a stereo microscope; fluorescein sodium ophthalmic strip staining photographed at 0, 1, 2 and 3 days

groups.description: Zeb1 wild-type (Zeb1+/+), 3-month-old, C57BL/6J background, mixed sexes; debridement only, no treatment
Zeb1 heterozygous knockout (Zeb1+/-), 3-month-old, C57BL/6J background, mixed sexes; genotype change (protocol: heterozygotes are treated)

exclusions.reason: Redundant derived representation: every '%' cell equals 100 x Area / the same row's 0d Area (checked); the raw 'Area' columns are used as area_absolute.
Group summaries; individual eye rows exist (protocol inclusion rule 3).
Statistical test output, not a measurement.

exclusions.what: Figure 1!B25:F29 (day-header row 25, genotype-labelled rows 26 and 28, unlabeled rows 27 and 29)
exclusions.reason: Group-level plotting summary block; individual eye rows exist (protocol inclusion rule 3).
TUNEL, Tnfa, Ki67 and Cdh1 histology quantifications, not fluorescein wound area (protocol inclusion rule 4).
In vitro primary corneal epithelial cell migration (gap) assay (protocol inclusion rule 4).

notes: Original time labels '0d', '1d', '2d', '3d' converted as days x 24 to 0, 24, 48, 72 h.

value_kind area_absolute: sheet column label 'Area' (Figure 1!C3/E3/G3/I3); caption: 'The debrided areas were measured with the software ImageJ'. Units are not stated (uncalibrated ImageJ area); each series is normalized by its own 0d area.
Methods wording: 'The fluorescein intensity of wound area was measured using the software ImageJ after cropping the entire corneal area and setting a fixed threshold'.

Each row is one debrided eye of one mouse (Methods: 'Only one cornea was debrided whereas the other eye remained untreated'). 'Eye' identifiers repeat across genotypes, so series ids include the genotype.

n_reported = 8 per genotype: Methods 'Eight 3-month-old Zeb1 wild-type (wt, Zeb1+/+) or heterozygous mutant (het, Zeb1+/-) mice' read together with the 8 eye rows per genotype in the sheet; the per-group n printed in Fig. 1b is not available as text.

Basement membrane status is not stated for the Alger Brush II debridement; recorded as unknown (protocol). The Results mention TNF 'released from the broken basal membrane' only as a mechanistic remark.
Source cells are written as '<verbatim sheet name>!<A1 reference>'.
No missing values: every series has all four time points.
